note: Seed rows carry only values read from the cited sources. Add your own materials with the materials library; no value here is invented.

materials.name: Stainless steel 304
materials.provenance: Density 7.880 g/cm3 at 295 K, Young's modulus 198.8 GPa at 300 K and Poisson's ratio 0.290 at 295 K from NBS IR 80-1627 Table 4 (https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/IR/nbsir80-1627.pdf). Young's modulus also agrees with the NIST cryogenic fit (Bradley and Radebaugh, https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=913059). The printed 99.6 GPa in the NBS table is a typo and is not used.

materials.name: Aluminium 6061
materials.provenance: Density 2.70 g/cm3 at 20 C, Young's modulus 10.0e3 ksi (68.9 GPa, typical) and Poisson's ratio 0.33 from the NASA Materials Data Handbook for Al 6061, CR-123772, 1972 (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19720022808/downloads/19720022808.pdf). NIST gives 70.10 GPa at 300 K for the modulus (Bradley and Radebaugh), about 1.7 percent higher; this row keeps the NASA typical value.

materials.name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V
materials.provenance: Density 4.424 g/cm3 at 20 C, Young's modulus 16.5e3 ksi (113.8 GPa, handbook abstract value; the design value is 16.0e3 ksi, 110.3 GPa) and Poisson's ratio 0.342 from the NASA Materials Data Handbook for Ti-6Al-4V, 1972 (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19720022814/downloads/19720022814.pdf). Single source: confirm against your own data before relying on it.
